title: SDG 12 責任消費及生產
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #12 Responsible Consumption and Production 責任消費及生產

slides.eyebrow_en: From Garbage Island to recycling champion
slides.eyebrow_zh: 從垃圾之島到回收模範生

strip.en: of trash per person a day, down from 1.14
strip.zh: 每人每天的垃圾，原本是 1.14

lines.en: In California, garbage trucks do not play music.
lines.zh: 在加州，垃圾車不會放音樂。

lines.en: In Taiwan, I heard a song at night — and everyone ran outside with their trash!
lines.zh: 在台灣，我晚上聽到一首歌——然後大家都拿著垃圾衝出門！

slides.ask_en: Today: what we buy, what we throw away, and what Taiwan can teach the world.
slides.ask_zh: 今天要談：我們買什麼、丟什麼，還有台灣可以教世界什麼。

slides.q_en: Which famous song do many Taiwanese garbage trucks play?
slides.q_zh: 台灣很多垃圾車播的是哪一首名曲？
slides.explain_en: Beethoven's Für Elise — and A Maiden's Prayer, by a Polish composer. The music says: the truck is here!
slides.explain_zh: 貝多芬的〈給愛麗絲〉，還有波蘭作曲家的〈少女的祈禱〉。音樂一響就是說：垃圾車來了！

slides.ask_en: Dom's home and yours: two very different ways to take out the trash.
slides.ask_zh: Dom 的家和你的家：兩種非常不一樣的倒垃圾方式。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever run after a garbage truck.
prompts.zh: 曾經追過垃圾車的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you help sort the recycling at home.
prompts.zh: 在家有幫忙做資源回收分類的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you threw away something this week that still worked.
prompts.zh: 這星期丟過還能用的東西的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: Recycling is good. Not throwing things away is even better.

slides.head_en: From Garbage Island to Recycling Champion
slides.head_zh: 從垃圾之島到回收模範生

stops.en: Only 70% of trash is collected. The rest is dumped or burned.
stops.zh: 只有七成垃圾被收走，其餘被亂丟或燒掉

stops.en: Trash must not touch the ground — you bring it to the truck
stops.zh: 垃圾不落地——自己把垃圾拿去垃圾車
推動「四合一資源回收計畫」

stops.en: Each person throws away 1.14 kg a day
stops.zh: 每人每天丟 1.14 公斤垃圾

stops.en: Under 0.4 kg a day — and over half is recycled
stops.zh: 每天不到 0.4 公斤，超過一半被回收

slides.note_en: In one generation, Taiwan changed how everyone lives. People did this — not machines.
slides.note_zh: 一個世代之間，台灣改變了每個人的生活方式。做到的是人，不是機器。

slides.head_en: of Taiwan's trash is recycled today
slides.head_zh: 台灣今天超過 55% 的垃圾被回收
slides.body_en: Taiwan is now one of the best recyclers in the world.
slides.body_zh: 台灣現在是全世界資源回收做得最好的地方之一。
slides.ask_en: But which is better — recycling a bottle, or never needing a new one?
slides.ask_zh: 但哪一個更好——回收一個瓶子，還是根本不需要新瓶子？

slides.note_en: Careful — some of these are tricky!

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: A shop receipt goes in the paper recycling.
items.note_en: Receipts are thermal paper — the coating spoils the whole batch of paper.
items.note_zh: 發票是感熱紙，塗層會汙染整批回收紙。

items.zh: 台灣曾經被叫做「垃圾之島」。
items.note_en: In the 1990s. Look how far it has come!
items.note_zh: 在 1990 年代。看看現在進步了多少！

items.en: Recycling is the very best way to deal with trash.
items.zh: 資源回收是處理垃圾最好的方法。
items.note_en: Refusing and reducing come first. The best trash is trash you never make.
items.note_zh: 拒絕、減量排在前面。最好的垃圾，是從來沒產生的垃圾。

items.en: Buying less is one way to protect the Earth.
items.zh: 少買東西，也是保護地球的方法。
items.note_en: Everything we buy took water, energy and materials to make.
items.note_zh: 我們買的每樣東西，都用掉了水、能源和原料。

slides.head_zh: 你的手機最後去了哪裡？
slides.body_en: Metals dug from a mine. A factory far away. A ship, a shop, your hand — and a few years later, a drawer. Old phones still hold gold and copper that could be used again.
slides.body_zh: 從礦場挖出的金屬、遙遠的工廠，再經過船、商店，到你手上——幾年後，進了抽屜。舊手機裡還有可以再利用的金和銅。

slides.ask_en: Your moon-lute club keeps old Taiwanese songs alive. What do YOU own that you will keep and care for?
slides.ask_zh: 你們的月琴社讓老歌繼續流傳。你有什麼東西，會好好照顧、用很久？

slides.q_en: You are thirsty at school. Which choice saves the MOST?
slides.q_zh: 你在學校口渴了。哪一個選擇最省資源？

options.en: Buy a bottle, then recycle it
Buy a bottle, then throw it away
Buy two bottles to be safe

slides.explain_en: Your own bottle! No new bottle is made at all — that is refuse and reuse.
slides.explain_zh: 自己的水壺！根本沒有新瓶子被製造——這就是拒絕與重複使用。

slides.prompt_en: What is one thing you could stop buying — and what could you use instead?
slides.prompt_zh: 有什麼東西你可以不再買？可以改用什麼代替？
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many things you can recycle in English as you can. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「可以回收的東西」越好，我來數！

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me one thing you will stop throwing away.
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我一件你決定不再丟掉的東西。

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Carry your own bottle and bag — refuse the new one.
items.zh: 帶自己的水壺和袋子——拒絕新的。

items.en: Before you buy, ask: do I need it, or just want it?
items.zh: 買之前先問：我需要，還是只是想要？

items.en: Help sort the recycling at home — no receipts with the paper!
items.zh: 在家幫忙分類回收——發票不要跟紙類放一起！
拒絕、減量、重複使用、修理、回收。

items.en: The best trash is no trash.
items.zh: 最好的垃圾，是沒有垃圾。

items.en: Do I need it, or do I want it?

slides.q_en: In California, when a truck drives down the street playing music, what is it doing?
slides.q_zh: 在加州，一輛車放著音樂開過街道，它在做什麼？
slides.explain_en: Selling ice cream! So when Dom first heard Für Elise in Taiwan, she wanted ice cream — and got a garbage truck.
slides.explain_zh: 賣冰淇淋！所以 Dom 第一次在台灣聽到〈給愛麗絲〉時，以為有冰淇淋——結果來的是垃圾車。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Wanlai Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — tell me what you will stop throwing away.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到萬來國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴我你決定不再丟掉什麼。

slides.big_en:
Buy less. Keep longer.
Throw away less.
slides.big_zh: 少買一點、用久一點、少丟一點。
